The '''Outlander Boltblaster's blaster rifle MK-6''' was a model of [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] used around the time of the [[Galactic War]], the [[Eternal Empire conquest]], the [[War against Zakuul]]<ref name="KotFE" /> and the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR:DAR">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=weekly|Daily Area: Ruhnuk|Ruhnuk}}</ref>

Outlander Boltblaster's blaster rifles widely equipped [[Mandalorian shock trooper]]s during the [[Mandalorian civil war (Third Galactic War)|Mandalorian civil war]] of the Third Galactic War,<ref name="TOR:DAR" /> including [[Jekiah Ordo]],<ref name="TOR:SoV">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=flashpoint|Spirit of Vengeance}}</ref> [[Davran]],<ref name="TOR:DAR" /> [[Jemala Ha'rangir]],<ref name="TOR:OTR">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|On The Run|Tatooine}}</ref> and many [[Dar'manda]] troopers.<ref name="TOR:DAR" /> Outlander Boltblaster's blaster rifles MK-6 were also used by [[the Brothers]] on [[Mek-Sha]],<ref name="TOR:TRZ">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=location|The Red Zone|Mek-Sha}}</ref> as well as by [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Tilos Pak]] of the [[Syphus Collective]] on [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]].<ref name="TOR:SSJ">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=heroic|Supply-Side Justice|[[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]]}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Outlander Boltblaster's blaster rifle MK-6 appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. It was introduced in [[2015]] as a player reward for completing the first chapter of [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']].<ref name="KotFE" /> The weapon was later attributed to many non-player characters.<ref name="TOR:DAR" />
